## What the error means

CUDA graph capture records the stream operations into a graph. During capture,
the default ("legacy") stream has special semantics: it is implicitly
synchronized with all other streams. The error

```
operation would make the legacy stream depend on a capturing blocking stream
```

is raised when a stream that is being captured (a "capturing blocking stream")
is made to wait on, or be waited on by, the legacy stream in a way that the
graph runtime cannot represent. Concretely, the offending pattern in your code
is:

```python
main_stream = current_stream()          # this is the legacy stream
tier_stream.wait_stream(main_stream)    # aux waits on legacy  -> illegal
...
main_stream.wait_stream(tier_stream)    # legacy waits on aux  -> illegal
```

`current_stream()` inside `capture()` returns the legacy stream, and any
`wait_stream` involving it during capture is disallowed. The graph machinery
treats the legacy stream as a synchronization barrier; you cannot express
"legacy waits on a captured stream" or "captured stream waits on legacy" inside
the graph.
